newsitem.title: QATAR: Qatar shares advance slowly, more gains seen.
newsitem.headline: Qatar shares advance slowly, more gains seen.

text.p: Shares at Qatar's unofficial stock market maintained their slow advance in the week to Thursday, with brokers expecting a further improvement in price and activity in the run-up to year-end.
Six shares moved up, nudging the Commercial Bank of Qatar's 18-share index to 121.99 points from 121.86 the previous week.

"There is clearly excess demand in the market for most major stocks and we expect a major upward movement in the index in the next weeks," said Mazin al-Shakarchi, senior investment manager at the Commercial Bank (CBQ).
Gainers in the week included CBQ and Doha Bank, up a respective two riyals and one riyal at 342 and 280 riyals.

Others were Qatar Navigation and Qatar Cement which each added two riyals to 715 and 307. Qatar Islamic Bank and Qatar International Islamic Bank crept up half a riyal each to 122.50 and 85 riyals respectively.
